ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of China’s population distribution, and a dividing line can be seen slanting from near Heihe in the northeast direction to near Tengchong in the southwest direction, namely the Heihe–Tengchong Line; the southeast side of this line has darker shading and denser population distribution, while the northwest side has a wider area but lower population density. Therefore, one reason why the population density on the west side is relatively low is that the ecological environment is fragile.
